A key not yet present in a partial build fails DEAD-ENTRY until the tree is assembled (that is the claim being checked). Kit-root files (tools/kit/*, shipped by build/root onto main) are catalogued HERE too, helpers included: on an assembled main every in-scope file needs an entry (fix2-commons 1: tools/kit/_kit.py had none and assembly STOPPED at step 3).
